premarket.market_expectations: Markets lean bullish with S&P futures rising and dollar softening, though Nasdaq weakness tempers optimism. Domestic institutional buying offsets FII outflows, while falling crude and bond yields provide tailwinds. The rupee's strength and VIX decline suggest stable conditions, but positioning in the top-third range warrants caution against profit-taking.
